cohort: The cohort consisted of 143 Malaysian women aged over 18 with registered gestational diabetes mellitus, who had their first antenatal visit in the first trimester, excluding those with pre-existing diabetes, chronic illnesses, or multiple pregnancies.
finding: Abnormal pre-pregnancy BMI was linked to Caesarean section, and abnormal gestational weight gain was associated with maternal complications.
mod_finding: Abnormal pre-pregnancy BMI was significantly associated with delivery mode (p<0.036), with 80.4% of respondents undergoing Caesarean section having abnormal pBMI.
cross-section timing: Data collected from June 2020 to June 2022, and the study was conducted from January to June 2023.
